newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank repo drains 68 bln skr from market.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank repo drains 68 bln skr from market.

text.p: Sweden's Riksbank (central bank) said on Tuesday it drained 68 billion crowns from the market in the morning's reverse repurchase tender set at a fixed rate of 5.05 percent.
The repo will run from October 2 to October 9, and replaces a seven-day reverse repurchase operation that drained 62 billion crowns from the market.
The repo rate, which is the central bank's key monetary policy tool, was last cut on September 24 to 5.05 percent from 5.15 percent.
